Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Contacts. See everyone you email with — across all your accounts — and your whole history with each person in one place. Open it from the sidebar, View › Contacts (⌥⌘C), or "All Mail with…" when you click someone's name. Click a conversation to jump straight to it.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Dark mode reading. Newsletters, calendar invites and other designed emails are no longer hard to read in dark mode, and your own messages and replies keep the dark look with readable signatures.
  • Fewer false "codes". Emails with addresses, phone numbers or order numbers no longer show a verification code that isn't there.
  • Calendar invites no longer list the invite file twice.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • A cleaner What's New. This window has a new look, with earlier updates tucked away under Earlier updates.

Bug fixes

  • Menu bar icon. The unread count now has proper spacing next to the envelope.
